_doc: AB-HARNESS-1 (agent_issues 2828). The model each governed worker is declared to use. qnfo-model-eval reads this file from main every hour; a worker whose model here differs from the one it last saw gets a paired A/B run (pre-change baseline against the new model, judged by two other model families) written to qnfo-audit.model_ab_runs, and a regression files an agent_issues row. A worker listed for the first time is only recorded as the baseline. Entry: "<worker>": { "model": "<model id>", "task_set": "grounded-qa|summarize|reasoning-short|clef-classification", "threshold": 0.4, "live_pre": false }. Only model is required. No worker is listed yet: the changes nobody declares are found from ai_call_counters (a model a worker newly uses), so an empty list does not leave a change unmeasured.
